mods.title: BETTER SURVIVAL Chapter 2
mods.summary: A Survival overhaul that reduces repetitive gathering, shortens crafting and refining waits, and makes a fresh Chapter 2 run move faster.
mods.bestFor: Players who want a less grind-heavy 1.0 Survival run
mods.whyRecommended: This is the strongest current Scrap Mechanic Survival mod candidate in this list because it was built and updated after 1.0, targets a clear player pain point, and documents exactly how progression changes.
mods.installMethod: Manual game-file install; the author requires the -dev launch option
mods.imageAlt: BETTER SURVIVAL Chapter 2 Steam Workshop preview
features: Halves crafting time and raises refining output by roughly three to ten times.
Raises mining and natural-resource yields, increases stack sizes, and halves selected trader costs.
Doubles engine efficiency and triples much of the loot, shifting the focus from grind to building.
mods.caution: This is not a normal one-click Parts mod: it replaces Survival files, requires -dev, disables Steam achievements, and can be undone by game updates or file verification. Back up the original folders and use a separate world.

mods.title: HEAVY-DUTY VEHICLE PARTS
mods.summary: A fast-growing vehicle pack for highway trucks, construction equipment, aircraft cockpits, mining machines, and recovery builds.
mods.bestFor: Builders who want functional truck, towing, and machinery components
mods.whyRecommended: It is a practical post-1.0 recommendation rather than a cosmetic filler pack: recent updates, a focused industrial theme, and scripted recovery and logic tools give builders several new systems to work with.
mods.installMethod: Subscribe in Steam Workshop, then enable the Parts mod for the world
mods.imageAlt: HEAVY-DUTY VEHICLE PARTS Steam Workshop preview
features: Adds fifth wheels, recovery ropes, tow hooks, winches, seats, wheels, tires, hubs, propellers, and cockpit controls.
CB radios and antennas transmit logic wirelessly; several adjustable parts include their own settings panels.
Includes English and Chinese localization and host-only safeguards for the world-cleaner tool.
mods.caution: Scripted parts are a stronger dependency than ordinary blocks. Test steering, saves, and multiplayer joining before using the pack in an important world.

mods.title: Solid
mods.summary: A compact but ambitious interactive-parts collection for guided weapons, aircraft, ships, large builds, and experimental control systems.
mods.bestFor: Creative combat prototypes, aircraft, ships, and large machines
mods.whyRecommended: Solid is worth watching because it was updated just after 1.0 and covers unusual jobs that broad block packs rarely solve, from mouse-delta controls to configurable buoyancy and build cameras.
mods.installMethod: Subscribe in Steam Workshop and test it in a disposable Creative world
features: Adds predictive homing magnets, flares, configurable missiles, targeting pods, and laser-guided weapons.
Includes adjustable wings, thrusters, parachutes, buoyancy barrels, inertia blocks, and an infinite floor.
Build camera, mouse-delta input, single-tick buttons, and improved logic gates help with complex creations.
mods.caution: The small current audience means there is less public compatibility evidence. Use a disposable Creative world before importing a valuable blueprint.

mods.title: New Legend Mod (Creative)
mods.summary: The Workshop's number-one item by total unique subscribers, combining a very large Creative parts library with a huge legacy blueprint ecosystem.
mods.bestFor: Legacy Creative builds that already depend on its parts
mods.whyRecommended: New Legend matters because it sits at the top of the all-time Workshop ranking and thousands of older creations depend on it. It is a preservation and variety pick, not evidence of current 1.0 support.
mods.installMethod: Subscribe for a Creative world or when a blueprint lists it as a dependency
mods.imageAlt: New Legend Mod Creative Steam Workshop preview
features: Covers building materials, geometry, interactive parts, weapons, vehicle pieces, decorations, and architecture.
Ranks #1 by total unique subscribers in the Scrap Mechanic Workshop.
More than 27,000 Workshop items list it as a required dependency.
mods.caution: The Workshop item predates 1.0 by years and Steam marks it as incompatible. Use it only after checking the author's page, required items, and recent player reports.

mods.title: Interactive Parts Mod by Lord Pain
mods.summary: A classic functional-parts library used by thousands of older logic systems, vehicles, mechanisms, and downloadable blueprints.
mods.bestFor: Opening or preserving older creations that require it
mods.whyRecommended: Its #3 all-time subscriber ranking and more than 12,000 dependent Workshop items make it essential context for legacy blueprints, even though it is not a safe default for a new 1.0 world.
mods.installMethod: Subscribe only for the Creative world or blueprint that requires it
mods.imageAlt: Interactive Parts Mod by Lord Pain Steam Workshop preview
features: Adds interactive building components used throughout the older Creative blueprint library.
Ranks #3 by total unique subscribers and has more than 12,000 dependent Workshop items.
Best treated as a dependency-driven install rather than a general 1.0 recommendation.
mods.caution: Its last recorded update is from 2020. Keep a legacy mod list with the blueprint or world that needs it and never test removal on the only save.

mods.title: Wings
mods.summary: A purpose-built aerodynamics mod that adds real lift, control surfaces, drag reduction, and diagnostic tools for flying creations.
mods.bestFor: Legacy aircraft, helicopters, and flight experiments
mods.whyRecommended: Wings remains the clearest answer to the long-tail search for a Scrap Mechanic airplane mod: it models lift instead of merely adding aircraft-shaped blocks and ranks #6 all time.
mods.installMethod: Subscribe for a Creative world, then verify every required aircraft dependency
features: Modular wings create lift and can be shaped into aircraft or helicopter control surfaces.
A drag-reducer block and center-of-mass, weight, and thrust tools help tune flight behavior.
Ranks #6 by total unique subscribers and is required by more than 7,000 Workshop items.
mods.caution: The item has not been updated since 2020. Confirm 1.0 behavior in a clean Creative test world before loading an aircraft collection that depends on it.
